product.identity_boundary: The product is the machinery that preserves meaning across this chain. A DomainSpec document, generated file, validator, receipt, or ontology projection is one part of that machinery; no single artifact is the product by itself.
product.name: DomainSpec
product.purpose: Software should not be built from prose, naming conventions, and architectural memory alone. DomainSpec makes the intended system an explicit typed graph, selects an exact implementation realization for every supported concept, materializes that realization deterministically, and compares the resulting project with the selected intent using bounded evidence.
